text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! Claiming a brilliant victory
in the Flora Stakes, the prelude to the Oaks, is—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, Ikuno Dictus!
Looks like medium distances are well within your reach!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
With Daiichi Ruby running too,
this year's Oaks is bound to be thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...Alright. I got a really good feel for things
going into the Oaks...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (With this, I can fight at 2400m too...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Once again, through your eyes as a Trainer,
how did my running look?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think you can definitely compete at medium distance too...!
Yeah, I think you can definitely compete at medium distance...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's race confirmed she has raw talent.
However, we cannot let our guard down just yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks is 400m longer than today, and the Umamusume running will be even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With our remaining time,
we must solidify our strategy for the 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've been prepared for a long time.
Please, don't hold back on the strict training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks is right around the corner. I must do everything I can with the time that remains—"
